props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: Where a swipe dismisses it: the edge it slides out through.

props.name: swipeThreshold
props.description: How far a swipe must travel to dismiss, in px. Default: half the popup's size along the direction. A fast flick (0.5 px/ms) dismisses whatever the distance.

props.name: modal
props.description: As DialogRoot: modal by default, closed by Escape and a press outside.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

parts.name: DrawerPopup
parts.description: Spread on a <dialog>: Dialog's popup, plus `data-swipe-direction`, `data-swiping`, `data-swipe-dismiss` and the `--drawer-swipe-movement-x`/`-y` and `--drawer-swipe-progress` variables (which its ::backdrop inherits). A stylesheet translates it by the movement; below the threshold the movement returns to 0 and it snaps back. It closes after its exit animation, under `[data-ending-style]`, from wherever it was let go.

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-direction
dataAttributes.description: The direction it can be swiped away in.

dataAttributes.name: data-swiping
dataAttributes.description: Present while the part is being dragged.

parts.name: DrawerContent
parts.description: Holds the drawer's content. A mouse press inside it selects text instead of starting a swipe.
